nodes.label: Badge Logo
nodes.summary: Brand badge/logo for Maintainarr (now Warden). Shows a teal/dark-teal gear icon containing a network/hub graph node motif (central node with 6 satellite nodes), set against a dark navy/charcoal square background. The product name 'Maintainarr' is displayed in teal text below the gear. A small decorative star/sparkle appears in the bottom-right corner. Color palette: dark navy background, teal/cyan gradient gear, white node dots, teal typography. Style is flat/semi-skeuomorphic, suitable for app store badges, GitHub repo headers, or sidebar branding.
